label: Levied by
note: There is no state property tax in Pennsylvania; bills combine county, municipal and school millage.
source_title: Jefferson County, Pennsylvania (county government): Property Tax

label: State oversight
value: State Tax Equalization Board (STEB) / Tax Equalization Division, Department of Community and Economic Development
note: Certifies school district market values and each county's common level ratio; assessment itself is done by counties.
source_title: Pennsylvania DCED: State Tax Equalization Board (STEB)/Tax Equalization Division (TED)

label: State realty transfer tax rate
note: 1% of the value of real estate transferred by deed, instrument, long-term lease or other writing; 15% of collections go to the Keystone Recreation, Park and Conservation Fund.
source_title: Pennsylvania Department of Revenue: Realty Transfer Tax

label: Who pays
value: Seller (grantor) and buyer (grantee) are jointly and severally liable
note: In practice the split is set in the sale contract.
source_title: Pennsylvania Department of Revenue: Realty Transfer Tax

label: Local realty transfer tax
value: Usually 1% (more in some localities), often shared between the municipality and school district
note: Collected with the state tax by the county Recorder of Deeds.
source_title: Pennsylvania Department of Revenue: Realty Transfer Tax, New Home Construction

label: Main exemptions
value: Certain transfers among family members, to government units, between religious organizations, to shareholders or partners, inheritances, burial sites and certain farm transfers
note: Abbreviated list from the Department of Revenue; full rules are in the realty transfer tax law.
source_title: Pennsylvania Department of Revenue: Realty Transfer Tax
